pages.title: Keep a balanced supply
pages.text: Ariente machines usually need $(item)Negarite flux$() and $(item)Posirite flux$() together. A demand of 100 means 100 of $(thing)each$(). If either supply runs short, the machine can stop.$(br2)For example, 5,000 Negarite and 1,000 Posirite provide only 1,000 paired units. Build up the weaker supply first.

pages.title: Plan for running power
pages.text: Flux is a continuous supply. Unused generation does not build a permanent battery reserve. Machines on a network share the available output.$(br2)Keep fuel flowing while your workshop runs. Ariente machines use their own flux system.$(br2)A Flux Capacitor is a crafting component. An Energy Holder carries fuel dust for equipment.
